meta.name: Mobility PWA Stopover Demo
meta.notes: Demonstrates a mobile-first travel stopover flow with citizen chatter, linked chat bubbles, and budget follow-ups.

steps.message: Mobility preset booted for mobile/PWA travel planning.
RECOMMEND 3 hidden gems in Singapore, 6 hour flight stopover at Changi Airport

steps.status: Mobility preset: finding fast airport-to-city hops for a short stopover.

steps.snippet: Changi Jurassic Mile for a quick open-air ride/walk before leaving the airport zone.
Katong-Joo Chiat for murals, kopi, and Peranakan snacks within a manageable cab hop.
The Intan area for a quieter heritage stop if you want culture without an all-day detour.

steps.message: Try a mobility-balanced route: Jurassic Mile, Katong-Joo Chiat, then a quick heritage stop before heading back to Changi.
I optimise for transit time, queue risk, and walking comfort so the route still feels relaxed on a phone-sized itinerary.
Mobility preset keeps the chain compact: airport edge -> east side food/culture -> return buffer.

steps.status: Rebalancing mobility plan for spend, comfort, and return-to-airport buffer.

steps.snippet: Keep transport lean: use MRT for the city leg, reserve ride-hailing for the final airport return only if timing slips.
Food and tickets stay comfortable under SGD300 if you anchor around Katong and skip long-ticket attractions.
Keep a 90-minute return cushion to Changi so the stopover feels smooth on mobile.

steps.message: With SGD300, prioritise MRT + short last-mile hops, one heritage/cafe cluster, and a generous return buffer to Changi.
Tap any Mobility bubble to continue with tighter constraints like 'Near MRT only' or 'More local food, less walking'.
